The signature can't be transcribed as text (it's a signature, maybe note it as [signature]?). The rule says text embedded in images must be transcribed. A signature isn't text exactly, but perhaps I should indicate it. I'll include a placeholder like *[handwritten signature]* — but the instructions say "Do not summarize, translate, annotate, or omit anything." Hmm, annotating is prohibited. But a signature has no text to transcribe. I could describe it minimally. I think a small italic note like *[signature]* is acceptable since the rules require text in images to be transcribed; a signature is an image with no legible text. I'll include *[handwritten signature]* as a marker. Actually to be safe, I'll include it since omitting entirely might seem like omission. The instruction "annotated" likely means don't add commentary. A placeholder marker for a signature seems reasonable.

The "101" rotated text at bottom-left of both pages — I'll include it as "101" (rotated). I can note it's rotated... but no annotations. I'll just include 101 maybe as a small note. Hmm. Let me just include it as text.
